stories.title: FCDO opens £750,000 Albania migration grant competition
stories.summary: Up to £750,000 is available for behavioural-insights and social-norm interventions in Albania, December 2026–March 2028. Eligible organisations and consortia can apply by 19 November; this is a grant call, not an award.

stories.title: DWP seeks evidence on State Pension deferral
stories.summary: Responses are invited until 1 December on why people defer, understanding of options and barriers. This evidence-gathering exercise proposes no specific policy change.

stories.title: Money and Pensions Service publishes annual accounts
stories.summary: The DWP-funded independent organisation published its 2025–26 activities and accounts. This concerns the year ending March 2026, not a new funding or supplier announcement.

stories.title: Water bosses report drought resilience measures
stories.summary: Following Monday’s National Drought Group meeting, companies reported leak detection, transfers and supply-protection measures. Some permits are granted but non-essential-use bans remain under consideration; this is not a new drought declaration.

stories.title: Defra promotes biodiversity research competition
stories.summary: A new Defra blog highlights an open GCBC call focused on the Amazon, Congo Basin and Coral Triangle. The cited £40m concerns the existing research portfolio, not this round’s value or a new award.

stories.title: RAF Typhoons to fly defensive missions for Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: MoD announced defensive counter-air missions, A400M transport support and military advisers in response to Houthi attacks. Typhoons will not conduct offensive strikes; no new equipment contract is announced.

stories.title: Farmer family’s MoD civil case adjourned
stories.summary: BBC reports the case is expected to resume in January after new material emerged. This is a procedural development since yesterday’s report; MoD denies liability and allegations are not judicial findings.

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

stories.title: Tech employers pledge 10,000 work experiences over three years
stories.summary: A joint DCMS/BIST announcement names Microsoft, Cisco, IBM, Cognizant, Arm, Kainos, QinetiQ and AtkinsRéalis. A separate 20,000 annual entry-level-role target can include existing vacancies; neither figure means jobs delivered or awarded supplier contracts.

stories.title: Research finds weaker support for NHS founding principles
stories.summary: The Guardian reports King’s Fund/Ipsos analysis showing declining support between 2021 and 2025, though large majorities still support free, universal, tax-funded care. This is survey analysis, not an NHS funding-model change.

stories.title: Royal Mail user issues reported during Google Cloud outage
stories.summary: The Guardian cites Downdetector reports involving Royal Mail during a London cloud power incident; Google says cloud services were restored. This does not independently establish Royal Mail’s root cause, delivery disruption or a supplier award.
